product.title: All Inclusive Isla Mujeres Catamaran

description.text: In Cancun, this all-inclusive catamaran day sails from Playa Tortugas toward Isla Mujeres with snorkeling gear, lunch, snacks, and an open bar on board. The crew handles boarding, reef timing, and the island stop so visitors can stay with Caribbean water and beach time rather than ferry tickets. A snorkel stop is included when conditions allow, then the boat continues to Isla Mujeres for free time before the return sail. Restrooms on board and unlimited non-alcoholic and alcoholic drinks keep the full-day format straightforward for hotel-zone visitors. The outing is a scenic sailing day rather than a private charter, with a dock tax collected for Tortugas Beach as listed on the live product. Departures are confirmed at booking in Cancun, and the itinerary stays on the catamaran, the snorkel stop, and Isla Mujeres rather than adding extra ruins or mainland beach clubs.
